name: Wine Shop Advert
summary: Renato Gallina draws passersby to his family's wine shop in Stormwind. He offers a voucher for a free bottle of vintage wine at their canal-side storefront, a small sign of trade in the rebuilt capital.

sections.title: A Taste of the Canals
sections.body: In Stormwind's Trade District, commerce fills the cobbled streets. Renato Gallina walks among them, promoting Gallina Winery, the small shop he runs with his sister, Suzetta. He hands flyers to thirsty travelers and locals. Each offers a free tasting.

sections.title: The Pinot Noir Vintage
sections.body: The Gallina family offers a bottle of their famous pinot noir. Follow the ticket to the winery entrance near the canals, where Suzetta Gallina hands over the bottle. The family hopes a taste of their signature wine will bring newcomers back.

faq.q: Where is the Gallina Winery located?
aliases: where is wine shop advert turned in
faq.answer: Gallina Winery is in Stormwind City's Trade District, along the canals near Renato Gallina's route.

faq.q: Who are Renato and Suzetta Gallina?
faq.answer: Renato and Suzetta Gallina are siblings who run a wine shop in Stormwind. Renato promotes it with flyers, while Suzetta tends the shop and serves the wine.

faq.q: What wine does the ticket earn?
faq.answer: The ticket earns a bottle of the Gallinas' famous pinot noir, their signature red wine.

faq.q: Why does Renato give out free wine tickets?
faq.answer: Renato gives out free wine tickets to draw customers into the canal-side shop and encourage them to return.

faq.q: Does this errand involve any danger or combat?
faq.answer: No. You take a promotional ticket from Renato and walk a short distance through the safe streets of the Trade District to Suzetta at the storefront.

faq.q: Does the Gallina Winery sell other goods?
faq.answer: Suzetta stocks standard wines and other alcoholic drinks for travelers, guards on break, and local tavern suppliers.

angles.text: The Gallinas' pinot noir pairs with hearty meals prepared in taverns across the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a human rebuilding a life in Stormwind, you may find family-run wineries along the canals a comforting sign of the city's revival.
Even in turbulent times, with kings missing and war underway, Stormwind's Trade District keeps a lively market for domestic luxuries and imported goods.
